title: Service appointment reminder
description: Remind customers of a car service appointment on WhatsApp with date, time and dealership address. Utility template for workshops.
notes: Mention the vehicle and service type so it reads as booking-specific. Confirm and reschedule buttons cut no-shows.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, this is a friendly reminder that your *{{service}}* for the {{vehicle}} is booked for {{date}} at {{time}}. We will see you at Acme Auto, 77 Garage Street. Please reply if you need to change anything.
